change: Remove Python highlight predicate rewriting/caching; retain native highlight queries, match-up caches, automatic input yielding, GC pacing and fastmacro.
baseline_adjustment: Frozen baseline and experimental targets include the same pre-existing SQL configuration edits; these edits are outside this change.
startup_method: Seven AB/BA rounds per scene/cache mode, discard first run; isolated state/log and per-target Lua bytecode cache; NVIM STARTED only, not display or LSP readiness. Cold recreates Neovim cache, not operating-system page cache.

wheel.scope:
Measure paced SGR wheel input through Neovim's core redraw in a PTY.

Uses kitty terminfo; does not launch kitty or measure its GPU/compositor display.
The observer records viewport changes at the end of decoration processing,
before terminal output reaches the display. Requires a POSIX PTY and Neovim.
Python msgpack controls the probe over RPC without opening the command line.
wheel.observer: Decoded wheel count paired with viewport changes including virtual rows and wrapped columns
wheel.control: Local RPC; only measured SGR wheel events enter the terminal input

editing_driver:
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, math, statistics
from pathlib import Path
base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('scroll', '/home/koishi/.config/nvim/scripts/benchmark-scroll.py')
scroll = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(scroll)
source = Path('/home/koishi/Projects/transformer/transformer.py')
digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
results = {'source_sha256':digest, 'rounds':[]}
code = '''
local api, ts = vim.api, vim.treesitter
function _G.StartupTradeoffCaptures()
  local buf, result = api.nvim_get_current_buf(), {}
  local parser = ts.get_parser(buf)
  parser:parse(true)
  parser:for_each_tree(function(tree, language)
    local lang = language:lang()
    local q = ts.query.get(lang, 'highlights')
    if not q then return end
    for id,node,metadata in q:iter_captures(tree:root(),buf,0,-1) do
      local capture = q.captures[id]
      local style = api.nvim_get_hl(0,{name='@'..capture..'.'..lang,link=false,create=false})
      result[#result+1] = {lang,capture,{node:range()},metadata,style}
    end
  end)
  return result
end
function _G.StartupTradeoffEdit()
  local line = api.nvim_buf_get_lines(0,69,70,false)[1]
  local now = vim.uv.hrtime()
  api.nvim_buf_set_text(0,69,#line,69,#line,{'x'})
  vim.cmd('redraw!')
  api.nvim_buf_set_text(0,69,#line,69,#line+1,{''})
  vim.cmd('redraw!')
  return (vim.uv.hrtime()-now)/1e6
end
return true
'''
def canonical(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict): return {str(k):canonical(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list): return [canonical(v) for v in value]
    return value

def captures(editor):
    rows=editor.call('nvim_exec_lua','return StartupTradeoffCaptures()',[])
    text=sorted(json.dumps(canonical(row),ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')) for row in rows)
    (editor.run / ('captures-before.json' if not (editor.run/'captures-before.json').exists() else 'captures-after.json')).write_text(json.dumps(canonical(rows), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
    return {'captures':len(rows),'sha256':hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(text).encode()).hexdigest()}
for index in range(2):
    for name in (['baseline','no_predicates'] if index == 0 else ['no_predicates','baseline']):
        run=base/'editing-final'/name/str(index)
        editor=scroll.Editor(base/name,run,source,'nvim')
        try:
            editor.drain(6)
            ready=editor.call('nvim_exec_lua',"local ready={} for _,client in ipairs(vim.lsp.get_clients({bufnr=0})) do ready[client.name]=client.initialized end assert(ready.basedpyright and ready.ruff and ready.typos_lsp); assert(#vim.diagnostic.get(0)==0); return ready",[])
            editor.call('nvim_exec_lua',code,[])
            editor.call('nvim_exec_lua',"for row=1,vim.api.nvim_buf_line_count(0),15 do vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(0,{row,0}); vim.cmd('normal! zt'); vim.cmd('redraw!') end vim.cmd('normal! gg'); vim.cmd('redraw!')",[])
            editor.drain(.3)
            before=captures(editor)
            editor.call('nvim_exec_lua',"vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(0,{70,0}); vim.cmd('normal! zz'); vim.cmd('redraw!')",[])
            editor.drain(.3)
            times=[]
            for _ in range(100):
                times.append(editor.call('nvim_exec_lua','return StartupTradeoffEdit()',[]))
                editor.drain(.008)
            editor.call('nvim_exec_lua',"vim.cmd('normal! gg'); vim.cmd('redraw!')",[])
            editor.drain(.2)
            after=captures(editor)
            assert before == after, (name,before,after)
            for old in results['rounds']: assert old['highlights'] == before, (old['name'],name)
            kept=times[10:]
            row={'name':name,'round':index,'lsp':ready,'highlights':before,'samples_ms':times,'p50_ms':statistics.median(kept),'p95_ms':sorted(kept)[math.ceil(len(kept)*.95)-1]}
            results['rounds'].append(row)
            print(name,index, json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k!='samples_ms'}),flush=True)
        finally: editor.close()
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
(base/'editing-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')

exploration.profiler_lua:
local times, wrapped = {}, {}
local native = require
function _G.require(name)
  local module = native(name)
  if not wrapped[name] and ({ ['user.core.treesitter_predicates']=true, ['user.core.matchup_cache']=true, ['user.core.matchup_bridge']=true, faster=true, ['user.core.statusline_refresh']=true, ['user.core.scrollview_refresh']=true, ['user.core.color_preview']=true })[name] then
    wrapped[name] = true
    local setup = module.setup
    if setup then
      module.setup = function(...)
        local start = vim.uv.hrtime()
        local result = {setup(...)}
        times[name] = (times[name] or 0) + (vim.uv.hrtime() - start) / 1e6
        return unpack(result)
      end
    end
  end
  return module
end
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd('VimEnter', {once=true, callback=function()
  vim.defer_fn(function()
    vim.fn.writefile({vim.json.encode(times)}, vim.env.NVIM_COST_OUTPUT)
  end, 100)
end})

limitations: Host load causes startup variation; control scenes are not evidence of unrelated speedups.
Wheel samples within a burst are correlated; four rounds do not establish a universal latency bound.
PTY timings exclude physical input, kitty GPU, compositor and display.
Synchronous editing/redraw timings do not measure end-to-end typing, completion or LSP latency.
